:::{#exr-off-diagonal-count}
#### Counting the off-diagonal entries of a square matrix

In a table of pairwise comparisons among $p$ items,
the [off-diagonal entries](#def-off-diagonal-entry) are the comparisons between two different items,
so counting them counts the ordered pairs of different items.
Let $\matr{A}$ be a $5 \times 5$ [matrix](#def-matrix),
so $\matr{A}$ is [square](#def-square-matrix).

How many off-diagonal entries does $\matr{A}$ have?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Count all the entries,
then subtract the [diagonal entries](#def-diagonal-entry).

:::

:::
